components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action that advances; hi-vis fill with a silver reflective base strip. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { padding-bottom: 5px; background: var(--hivis, #ff6a13); color: var(--hivis-ink, #1c232d); box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 var(--reflect, #c7ccd2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--hivis-deep, #e05a0a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--reflect, #c7ccd2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hivis, #ff6a13); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every non-advancing action: white with a strong hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b4bcc5); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); color: var(--ink, #1c232d); font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f6f7f8); border-color: var(--text-3, #626c78); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hivis, #ff6a13); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disabled States
components.description: Unavailable is struck through; loading shows a spinner; the drawer's current state carries a positive 'Estado actual' tag. Neither of the last two is struck.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-off { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--surface-3, #e9ecef); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d9de); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); color: var(--text-3, #626c78); font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-struck { color: var(--text-2, #4a5562); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--text-3, #626c78); text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; } .ds-loading { cursor: progress; } .ds-loading::before { content: ''; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--line-strong, #b4bcc5); border-top-color: var(--text-2, #4a5562); border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-spin 0.8s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } .ds-current-tag { padding: 2px 6px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b4bcc5); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text, #1c232d); font-family: var(--font-narrow, 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 48px field with a 1.5px strong hairline, tabular numerals and a hi-vis focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 360px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text, #1c232d); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong, #b4bcc5); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); color: var(--text, #1c232d); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--text-3, #626c78); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hivis, #ff6a13); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-hint { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-3, #626c78); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.45; }

components.css: .ds-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); height: 76px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: var(--ink-2, #2a3340); } .ds-seg { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 0 24px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--reflect-dim, #9aa3ad); border-left: 1px solid rgba(199,204,210,0.14); } .ds-seg:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-seg-num { font-family: var(--font-narrow, 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 2.125rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seg-text { font-family: var(--font-narrow, 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-done { color: var(--reflect-hi, #eef1f4); } .ds-done svg { color: var(--ok-on-dark, #86d6a6); flex: none; } .ds-done .ds-seg-text { font-weight: 500; } .ds-active { color: var(--hivis-ink, #1c232d); border-color: transparent; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--hivis, #ff6a13) 0 9%, var(--reflect, #c7ccd2) 9% 17%, var(--hivis, #ff6a13) 17% 83%, var(--reflect, #c7ccd2) 83% 91%, var(--hivis, #ff6a13) 91%); } .ds-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 50%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-110%); animation: ds-sheen 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 150ms 1 both; } @keyframes ds-sheen { to { transform: translateX(110%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-active::after { display: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The interface dresses like the worker's own personal protective equipment. A graphite shell bar carries the logo on a white plate; below it the page floor is a cold light grey and every working surface is white with a 1px hairline. Against that quiet field, one thing glows: a fluorescent orange band crossed by a double silver retroreflective stripe, worn only by whatever is active right now: the current phase, the one action that advances, the focus ring. Statuses speak the hard-hat code of a mining site (green conforme, red descarte, amber revisión, blue en curso, grey pendiente), each one an explicit mark with a square swatch and an uppercase narrow label.

Density follows the reader. The applicant portal is generous and touch-first (48px fields and buttons, 56px option cards, a 352px rail explaining why each document is asked for). The RR.HH. panel is a high-density module board: a five-cell metrics strip split by hairlines, a sticky-header matrix with 48px rows grouped action-first, and a right-hand drawer that opens the file without losing the matrix. Motion is brief and literal: a sheen crosses the reflective stripe when a phase activates, like headlights sweeping a vest, and a state cell flips like a split-flap board when it changes. Both stand down under reduced motion.

The system rejects the grey SaaS portal with a blue stepper and the earlier yellow-and-black hazard-stripe look. No gradients for atmosphere, no glass, no blur.
keyCharacteristics: Fluorescent orange is reserved; the reflective double stripe is the signature of "active".
Hard-hat state code for every status, always as an explicit labelled mark.
Archivo for reading, Archivo Narrow in caps for labels and tabular numerals.
Flat white modules on a cold grey floor, 1px hairlines, 6px corners.
Unavailable means struck through; loading and "current" are never struck.

rules.name: The Hi-Vis Reservation Rule
rules.body: Orange marks only what is active now: the current phase, the single primary action, focus, and the user's own current selection. Never decoration, never a heading, never an icon tint, never a second primary button on the same view.

rules.name: The Hard-Hat Code Rule
rules.body: Every status uses exactly one of the five state families, always as text colour on its own tint. Colour never carries state alone; it travels with an uppercase label and a square swatch.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or be compared (folios, scores, RUT, timers, counts, metrics, inputs) sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns and countdowns never jitter.

rules.name: The Caps Belong to Labels Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Narrow is for naming a field, column, metric, state or rail section. It never sits as a small tag stacked above a heading; context lines (such as quiz progress) run in sentence case.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px line or a tonal step first. Shadow is reserved for overlays; a resting module never gets more than the resting shadow.

dos: **Do** keep hivis to the current phase, the one primary action, the focus ring and the user's current selection; text on it is graphite.
**Do** draw the reflective stripe as hard-stop silver bands (9 to 17% and 83 to 91% on horizontal bands; flat vertical bands on the login panel), never as a soft gradient.
**Do** show every status as a labelled hard-hat mark: square swatch, Narrow caps label, text colour on its own tint.
**Do** strike through the label of an unavailable button, and keep loading buttons (spinner) and the drawer's current-state button (positive "Estado actual" tag) unstruck.
**Do** set every comparable number in tabular numerals, and labels in Archivo Narrow caps.
**Do** order RR.HH. lists action first and keep column geometry fixed when a state changes.
**Do** separate with 1px hairlines and tonal steps; keep shadows to the resting and overlay values.
**Do** keep 48px fields and buttons and 44px minimum targets on the applicant side.
**Do** disable the phase sheen and the state flip under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** use orange for decoration, headings, icons, links, borders at rest or a second CTA.
**Don't** bring back the blue SaaS stepper or the yellow-and-black hazard stripe.
**Don't** add gradients for atmosphere, glass, blur or backdrop effects; the only gradient-built shapes are the hard-stop reflective stripe and the momentary sheen.
**Don't** stack a small uppercase tag above a heading; a pill above a heading must carry a real state.
**Don't** set interface text in monospace. The panel's raw OCR log and magic-link box currently use a system monospace stack for literal data; that is a carried exception, not a pattern to extend.
**Don't** use text glyphs or emoji as icons; icons are drawn SVG (2px stroke) inline or as masks.
**Don't** let colour carry a state without its label.
**Don't** use the legacy alias variables (`--ecf-*`, `--safety-yellow*`, `--status-*`, `--radius-terminal`) in new work; they exist only so existing JS keeps resolving.
